definitions.explanation: A person devoted to literature and the arts, in the tradition of the scholar-poet who also painted and practiced calligraphy. Mostly used about the past.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文人|ぶんじん}。
examples.english: A man of letters of the Meiji era.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文人|ぶんじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: Many literary figures stayed at this hot-spring inn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文人|ぶんじん}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{詩|し}→詩：02139_shi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧や⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: Edo-period literati not only wrote poetry but also enjoyed painting and calligraphy.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文人|ぶんじん}{画|が}: literati painting (a style of painting by scholar-amateurs)
- {文人|ぶんじん}{墨客|ぼっかく}: poets and painters, men of letters and art (a set phrase)
- ⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文人|ぶんじん}: Meiji-era literary figures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: writer, novelist (a profession, the modern everyday word)
- {文学者|ぶんがくしゃ}: literary figure; also a scholar of literature
- {武人|ぶじん}: military man (the traditional opposite)
